correctness.rationale: For all integers c≥1 and n≥0, the frozen proof derives Q(6h+j) for 2x+3y and its exact periodic adjacent difference e=(−1,1,0,0,0,1). With n=qc+r, the identity ΔP=1_{r=c−1}+Σ_{i=0}^q e(r+ic) handles the m=−1 endpoint. Coprime c≡±1 mod6 traverse one positive six-term block, and the only negative partial interval is a singleton at residue 0; at q=6 the final equality is n=7c−7 for c≡1 and n=7c−5 for c≡5 (c=1 special n=0). For gcd(c,6)>1, ΔP(6kc)=−1+kB_c<0 for all k≥0, with B_c<0. Independent DP checked all c=1..120 and n through 17c+18; these checks corroborate the complete modular proof.
